scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-program-ocr.mjs && npm run tokens && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.e2e:dist: npm run build && E2E_DIST=1 playwright test e2e/asama3.spec.ts e2e/asama4.spec.ts e2e/dosyalar.spec.ts e2e/davet.spec.ts e2e/acilis.spec.ts
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/prepare-program-ocr.mjs && npm run tokens && tsc -b && vite build --mode staging && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name bulus-kure-staging --branch master
scripts.deploy:prod: node scripts/prepare-program-ocr.mjs && npm run tokens && tsc -b && vite build --mode production && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ${CF_PROJECT:-bulus-kure} --branch main
scripts.mobil:build: node scripts/prepare-program-ocr.mjs && npm run tokens && tsc -b && vite build --mode mobil && cap sync
scripts.mobil:ios: npm run mobil:build && cap open ios
scripts.mobil:android: npm run mobil:build && cap open android
scripts.e2e:mobil: vite build --mode mobil && E2E_MOBIL=1 playwright test e2e/mobil.spec.ts
